summary: Verified bug fixes for randomization and coverage generation. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly with Generate Coverage button and Randomize functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix verified: random.choice() now correctly selects different assistants in consecutive calls (tested 5 calls, got 5 different people: Nellina, Silvia, Tatiana, Iliana, Leticia)
Bug fix verified: Coverage generation works for all 12 houses including Casa Unión (house_casa_unión_)
Frontend 'Generar Cobertura' button correctly appears when coverage.length === 0
Randomize modal works correctly with position selector (Tía/Asistente)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) POST /api/coverage/randomize-position/{house_id}/{year}/{month}/{position} now uses random.choice() and returns different people (verified with 5 consecutive calls returning 5 different assistants). 2) POST /api/coverage/generate/{year}/{month} creates entries for all 12 houses including Casa Unión. 3) Frontend shows 'Generar Cobertura' button when no coverage exists for selected month. 4) Randomize modal opens and works correctly. Staff database has 11 assistants and 26 caregivers/tías available for randomization.
